package.name: go2_gazebo
package.description: Gazebo Sim (gz-sim) bringup for the Unitree Go2 in "patrol mode": a kinematically-driven /cmd_vel robot (body glides via the VelocityControl system, legs animated by a joint-trajectory controller) with real simulated IMU, 2D LiDAR and RGB + depth cameras, bridged into ROS 2. A C++ go2_driver integrates /cmd_vel into /odom + TF and drives a trot-style leg gait.
